password.minLength: Password must be at least 8 characters long
password.matches: Password must contain at least one lowercase letter, one uppercase letter, one digit, one special character, and one dot

login.tagline: Your budget, anchored to your paydays.

fiftyCard.heading: 50% Needs
fiftyCard.body: Allocate half of your income to cover basic needs such as rent, food, utilities and transportation.

thirty.heading: 30% Wants:
thirty.body: Use 30% of your income for non-essential expenses or 'wants', such as entertainment, dining out, or personal purchases.

twenty.heading: 20% Savings and Debt
twenty.body: Reserve the remaining 20% for saving or paying off debt. This includes contributions to emergency funds, savings for long-term goals, or additional debt payments.

empty.heading: You haven't logged any expenses this period yet
empty.description: Once you add an expense, it'll show up here.

budgetEmpty.heading: You haven't logged an income for this period yet
budgetEmpty.description: Prospero calculates your budget from your last payment. Log one to see the breakdown.

error.heading: We couldn't load your current period
error.description: Try reloading the page. If the problem continues, contact us.

dashboard.paymentOverdue: your next payment was expected on {{date}}.

pendingReview.title_one: You have {{count}} Gmail-detected movement to confirm
pendingReview.title_other: You have {{count}} Gmail-detected movements to confirm
pendingReview.description: They already count in your totals, but without a category they are missing from the Needs, Wants and Savings bars.

home.noRecent: No expenses logged this period yet.

offline.title: Offline · Prospero
offline.heading: You're offline
offline.text: We couldn't load this screen. Check your connection and try again; your data is safe in your account.

swUpdate.text: A new version of Prospero is available.

quickAdd.title: New movement
quickAdd.invalidAmount: Enter an amount above 0, with up to 2 decimals.

edit.deleteExpenseHint: It stops counting in your budget. This can't be undone.
edit.deleteIncomeHint: It stops counting in your budget; if it was your payroll, the period is recalculated. This can't be undone.

review.title: To review
review.expenseQuestion: What kind of expense is it?
review.incomeQuestion: What kind of income is it?

empty.title: All caught up
empty.description: No Gmail movements are waiting for your review.

empty.title: No movements in this period
empty.description: What you log with the + button shows up here.

welcome.error: We couldn't save. Please try again.

frequency.title: How often are you paid?
frequency.hint: Prospero builds your budget from each payday, not from the calendar month.
frequency.BiweeklyHint: Two payments a month, even if the dates vary

split.title: How do you want to split each payment?
split.hint: You can change it anytime in More → Profile.

income.title: Log your last payment
income.hint: That's all it takes to see what's left this period.

register.title: Create your account
register.lead: Your budget, anchored to your paydays.
register.weakPassword: The password doesn't meet all the requirements yet

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.sentTo: We sent a link to activate your account to
checkEmail.hint: Open it on this same phone to continue right in the app. If it's not there, check Spam or Promotions.
checkEmail.resendError: We couldn't resend the email. Try again in a moment.
checkEmail.askLead: Enter the email you signed up with and we'll send you a new link.

success.title: Your account is active!
success.text: You can now sign in and set up your budget.

invalid.title: This link isn't valid
invalid.text: You may have used it already or it expired. Ask for a new one.

retry.title: We couldn't activate your account
retry.text: It was a connection problem. Try again.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.lead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.expiresIn: For security, this step expires in {{time}}
twoFactor.expired: This step expired for security. Sign in again.
twoFactor.wrongCode: That code isn't right. Use the one your app shows now.
twoFactor.error: We couldn't verify the code. Try again.
twoFactor.lostTitle: I lost access to my app
twoFactor.lostIntro: If you changed or lost your phone, you can link the app again with the key you saved when you turned verification on:
twoFactor.lostStep1: Install an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or another).
twoFactor.lostStep2: Add a new account and choose to enter the key by hand.
twoFactor.lostStep3: Paste the key: the app will show the same 6-digit code Prospero expects.
twoFactor.lostNoKey: If you didn't save the key, there's no way to recover access from the app for now.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.lead: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to create a new one.
forgot.sentText: If there's an account with that email, the link arrives in a few minutes. It expires in 1 hour.
forgot.sentHint: Open it on this same phone. If it's not there, check Spam or Promotions.
forgot.error: We couldn't send the link. Try again in a moment.

reset.title: Create a new password
reset.lead: Pick one you don't use on other sites.

done.title: Password updated
done.text: We signed you out on all your devices. Sign in with the new password.

invalid.title: The link expired or was already used
invalid.text: Links last 1 hour and work once. Ask for a new one.
